documents.html:
Document control procedure

Documented information

Controlled documents carry creation and approval records.

Planning of changes

A change request states its purpose before any change.

documents.name: NM-PRO-03-risk-and-objectives
documents.html:
Risk procedure

Actions to address risks and opportunities

Risks are scored on a five-by-five matrix and tracked.

Quality objectives and planning to achieve them

Objectives carry targets, owners, and timeframes.

documents.name: NM-PRO-04-nonconforming-output
documents.html:
Nonconforming output procedure

Control of nonconforming outputs

Suspect product is tagged HOLD and quarantined.

Nonconformity and corrective action

Root cause analysis feeds the CAPA record.

documents.name: NM-PRO-05-competence-training
documents.html:
Competence procedure

Competence

Training records verify role competence.

Awareness

Policy relevance is covered in team meetings.

documents.name: NM-PRO-06-operations-suppliers-release
documents.html:
Operations procedure

Control of externally provided processes, products and services

Suppliers are qualified before first order.

Release of products and services

No lot ships without QA sign-off.

documents.name: NM-QM-01-quality-manual
documents.html:
Northgate Quality Manual

Quality management system and its processes

Core processes are mapped with owners and measures.

Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation

Monthly scorecards track yield and complaints.

documents.name: NM-PRO-02-document-control
documents.html:
Procedure NM-PRO-02: Document Control

Creation and approval

A document is not effective until both signatures are recorded.

Planning changes to documents or processes

The requester completes a change request stating the purpose before any change is made.

documents.name: NM-PRO-03-risk-and-objectives
documents.html:
Procedure NM-PRO-03: Risk and Objectives

Risk register

Risks are identified, evaluated on a 5x5 scale, and tracked to planned actions.

Quality objectives

Annual objectives carry a target, owner, timeframe, and progress tracking.

documents.name: NM-PRO-04-nonconforming-output
documents.html:
Procedure NM-PRO-04: Nonconforming Output

Identifying and containing nonconforming output

Suspect product is tagged HOLD and quarantined the same shift.

Disposition of nonconforming devices

Dispositions are decided by the QA Manager or deputized approver listed on the signature sheet.

Corrective action

The owner performs root-cause analysis documented in the CAPA record.

documents.name: NM-PRO-05-competence-training
documents.html:
Procedure NM-PRO-05: Competence Training Awareness

Competence requirements

Sign-off requires the trainer's confirmation that the person performed the task correctly.

Awareness

Managers cover why the quality policy matters in quarterly team meetings.

documents.name: NM-PRO-06-operations-suppliers-release
documents.html:
Procedure NM-PRO-06: Operations Suppliers Release

Supplier selection and evaluation

Suppliers are qualified before first order and scorecards run quarterly.

Release

No lot ships until final inspection passes all acceptance criteria and QA signs the release record.

documents.name: NM-QM-01-quality-manual
documents.html:
Northgate Medical Devices Quality Manual

Process map

Five core process groups each have a named owner and measures reviewed monthly.

Monitoring and measurement

Monthly quality scorecards track first-pass yield and complaint rate.
